reason: Deny the authorization service and the microphone to guarded desktop processes, so an updater cannot raise an administrator prompt and the "agent finished" sound cannot raise a microphone prompt.
insert:
;; Desktop processes have no use for administrator prompts or microphone input,
;; and the app updater and the "agent finished" sound raise those prompts. Kept
;; last so no earlier rule re-allows them.
(if (string=? (param "GUI") "1")
  (begin
    (deny mach-lookup (global-name "com.apple.authd"))
    (deny device-microphone)))
